Getting Started

Modern API (Recommended)

Powerful.jl provides a composable API that separates problem definition from solution algorithm:

using Powerful
using PowerFlowData

# Load system
case = PowerFlowData.parse_network("cases/ieee14.raw")
sys = SystemModel(case)

# Define problem
prob = ACPowerFlowProblem(sys)

# Choose algorithm and solve
sol = solve(prob, NewtonRaphson())

# Access results
v = get_var(sol, :Bus, :v, 1)

Key Concepts

  • Problem Types: ACPowerFlowProblem, TDSProblem define what to solve
  • Algorithms: NewtonRaphson(), FastDecoupledXB(), RobustNewton() define how to solve
  • Formulations: PowerInjection(), CurrentInjection() define equation forms
  • Solutions: PowerFlowSolution, MultiIslandSolution contain results
  • Accessors: get_var() for accessing variables by external IDs

Module Structure

The package is organized into two main modules:

  • Powerful: Main module containing core DAE system, address management, power flow solvers, and utilities
  • Models: Power system component models (buses, loads, generators, branches, etc.)

The source code is organized into functional directories:

  • foundation/ - Core type system and traits
  • indexing/ - Address management and index mapping
  • dae/ - Differential-algebraic equation structures
  • system/ - High-level system operations
  • solvers/ - Power flow and time-domain simulation
  • topology/ - Network topology analysis
  • analysis/ - Advanced analysis tools (autodiff, sparsity)
  • access/ - Variable and parameter accessors
  • io/ - Reports and output formatting
  • models/ - Power system component implementations
